'''Saujutta-Ok-Topii''' was a [[Pan-preneur]] businesswoman who was a marketing lieutenant for [[Trigdale Metallurgy]], leading their marketing division during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the end of the Galactic Civil War, Trigdale abandoned their ties with many of the subdivisions of the company. Saujutta-Ok-Topii reformed her branch into [[Syndicate One]], changing the company into an arms manufacturer. She also setup [[Executive Results]] to act as a front company for Syndicate One, to smuggle and distribute the weapons.<ref name="Yard" />
